papers.title: PlanSightRAG: A Visual-First Multimodal RAG for Automating Question Answering and Compliance Checking for Civil Standard Plans
papers.authors: ["Nabaraj Subedi","Shuvo Dip Datta","Ahmed Abdelaty","Shivanand Venkanna Sheshappanavar"]
papers.rationale_zh: 与内容理解、规则合规和治理证据链高度相关，实验指标强且 benchmark 构造完整；扣分主要来自 agentic 审计延迟较高和领域集中在工程图纸。
papers.rationale_en: Highly relevant to content understanding, compliance, and evidence-grounded governance with strong metrics and a solid benchmark; points deducted for agentic latency and domain concentration.
papers.method_overview_zh: Visual-first multimodal RAG：页面/切片图像经 ColNomic-3B 生成 patch-level multi-vector 表征，MaxSim 检索证据，再由 Qwen2.5-VL 和 Planner–Retriever–Auditor–Synthesizer agent 完成问答与合规判定。
papers.method_overview_en: Visual-first multimodal RAG: page/tile images are encoded into patch-level multi-vector representations with ColNomic-3B, retrieved by MaxSim, then audited through Qwen2.5-VL and a Planner-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer agent.
papers.story_zh: OCR 会丢失几何、布局和局部标注；该方法保留原始视觉证据，用可追踪 agent 流程生成合规结论。
papers.story_en: OCR loses geometry, layout, and local annotations; the method keeps raw visual evidence and generates traceable compliance decisions through an agent workflow.
papers.innovation_zh: 把复杂视觉文档从 OCR→文本检索改为 patch-level visual retrieval，并把合规判断拆成可审计 agent 子步骤。
papers.innovation_en: It replaces OCR-to-text retrieval with patch-level visual retrieval and decomposes compliance checking into auditable agentic steps.
papers.key_metrics_zh: ColNomic-3B 在 1,898 页 five-DOT benchmark 上达到 92.69% Recall@5；BGE-M3+OCR 为 36.79%，VisionRAG 为 23.11%；合成合规图纸达到 100% verdict accuracy ceiling。
papers.key_metrics_en: ColNomic-3B reaches 92.69% Recall@5 on the 1,898-page five-DOT benchmark versus 36.79% for BGE-M3+OCR and 23.11% for VisionRAG; synthetic compliance drawings reach a 100% verdict-accuracy ceiling.

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Context-Enhanced RAG over Multimodal Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: ["Zongyu Wu","Yilong Wang","Xiaochen Wang","Minhua Lin","Zhichao Xu","Fenglong Ma","Xiang Zhang","Suhang Wang"]
papers.rationale_zh: 对多模态内容理解和 RAG 知识库建设直接有价值，方法轻量、可迁移；扣分在于公开摘要中缺少更强 SOTA 量化幅度和数据规模较小。
papers.rationale_en: Directly useful for multimodal content understanding and RAG knowledge-base construction; lightweight and transferable, but quantitative SOTA margins and dataset scale appear limited.
papers.method_overview_zh: 为每个视觉元素构建局部和全局文本上下文，并分别注入 image-to-graph 与跨模态图融合阶段，提升 MMKG-based GraphRAG 的语义对齐。
papers.method_overview_en: It builds local and global textual context for each visual element and injects them into image-to-graph construction and multimodal graph fusion to improve MMKG-based GraphRAG alignment.
papers.story_zh: 图片独立抽图会和分散文本脱节；CEMMKG 按粒度选择上下文，并在抽图/融合阶段分别利用。
papers.story_en: Image-only graph extraction is disconnected from dispersed text; CEMMKG selects multi-granularity context and uses it at both extraction and fusion stages.
papers.innovation_zh: 不替换底层 MLLM/RAG 框架，而是改造 context argument，工程成本低且适合图文内容理解。
papers.innovation_en: It augments the context argument rather than replacing the backbone MLLM/RAG framework, making it lightweight and transferable.
papers.key_metrics_zh: VisionHeavy 子集含 106 个问题，其中 80.2% 需要视觉信息、43.2% 依赖跨页证据；在 RAG-Anything 与 MMGraphRAG 上验证 strict/soft accuracy 提升。
papers.key_metrics_en: The VisionHeavy subset has 106 questions, 80.2% requiring visual information and 43.2% requiring cross-page evidence; gains are shown on RAG-Anything and MMGraphRAG backbones.

papers.title: A Visual Dependence-Aware Framework for Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training
papers.authors: ["Kaichen Li","Zhilin Zhu","Jianhao Huang","Zhengqin Lai","Baochen Xiong","Zibo Shao","Yaguang Song","Linhui Xiao","Xiaoshan Yang","Changsheng Xu"]
papers.affiliations: ["Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences","Pengcheng Laboratory","University of Chinese Academy of Sciences","Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen"]
papers.rationale_zh: 对无标注多模态数据持续学习、内容理解和数据质量有较高价值，实验覆盖多域；扣分在于与电商治理不是直接任务，且训练成本依赖 7B MLLM+LoRA。
papers.rationale_en: Valuable for unlabeled multimodal continual learning, content understanding, and data quality with broad experiments; less directly tied to ecommerce governance and requires 7B MLLM LoRA training.
papers.method_overview_zh: 估计 token-level visual dependence，用 VC-OT 保持旧任务视觉依赖结构，用 VMA 强化新任务视觉 token 学习，实现无答案多模态持续后训练。
papers.method_overview_en: It estimates token-level visual dependence, preserves old-task visual-dependence structure with VC-OT, and emphasizes visually grounded new-task tokens with VMA for answer-free multimodal continual post-training.
papers.story_zh: 无监督后训练容易从视觉证据漂移到语言模板；VDA 用视觉依赖作为权重和遗忘约束。
papers.story_en: Unsupervised post-training can drift from visual evidence to language templates; VDA uses visual dependence as both weighting signal and forgetting constraint.
papers.innovation_zh: 把 token 的视觉依赖纳入训练目标，兼顾新任务可塑性和旧任务稳定性。
papers.innovation_en: It turns token-level visual dependence into the training objective to balance new-task plasticity and old-task stability.
papers.key_metrics_zh: Qwen2.5-VL-7B 六任务顺序上 AvgAcc 62.5%，超过 ScPO 3.7 点、SEEKR-MLLM 2.4 点；AvgF 降至 0.6。
papers.key_metrics_en: With Qwen2.5-VL-7B over six tasks, VDA achieves 62.5% AvgAcc, +3.7 points over ScPO and +2.4 over SEEKR-MLLM; AvgF is 0.6.

papers.title: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: ["Junxiang Xu","Ruisi Wang","Fanyi Pu","Maijunxian Wang","Ran Ji","Tongxi Zhou","Chenyang Gu","Jing Zuo","Hongcan Xiao","Yimeng Geng","Wanqi Yin","Wei Chen","Oscar Qian","Zhengan Yan","Ziqi Huang","Haiwen Diao","Liang Pan","Bo Li","Xiangyu Fan","Dezhi Luo","Fengyuan Yu","Zehong Zhao","Qingying Gao","Tinghui Zhu","Yilan Zhang","Jingqi Tong","Pinyuan Feng","Zhengze Jiang","Letian Wang","Ziyu Guo","Renrui Zhang","Jieneng Chen","Sonia Joseph","Constantin Venhoff","Saman Motamed","Mengyue Yang","Chandra Sripada","Alan Yuille","Philip Torr","Lvmin Zhang","Vikash Kumar","Daniel Khashabi","Nikolaus Kriegeskorte","Raphaël Millière","Vincent C. Müller","Anyi Rao","Quan Wang","Ziwei Liu","Dahua Lin","Lei Yang","Hokin Deng","Zhongang Cai"]
papers.affiliations: ["Nanyang Technological University","University of California, Berkeley","University of California, San Diego","VBVR Community Contributors","The University of Tokyo","The Chinese University of Hong Kong","University of Michigan","Johns Hopkins University","Carnegie Mellon University","Stanford University","University of Oxford","HKUST"]
papers.rationale_zh: 论文质量很高、热度潜力强，但与电商内容生态/达人治理主要是方法启发，非直接应用，因此不进入 >=80 复现集合。
papers.rationale_en: High paper quality and strong momentum, but only indirectly relevant to ecommerce content and creator governance, so it is not reproduced under the >=80 rule.
papers.method_overview_zh: 构建 300 个程序化视觉推理任务，生成图像/视频/图文交错轨迹，并用确定性可验证 scorer 替代不稳定的 VLM-as-judge。
papers.method_overview_en: It builds 300 procedural visual reasoning tasks with image/video/interleaved trajectories and uses deterministic verifiable scorers instead of unstable VLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
papers.story_zh: 视觉推理缺少可扩展任务和稳定评价；VBVR-Pro 用程序生成器和规则 scorer 建立训练评测闭环。
papers.story_en: Visual reasoning lacks scalable tasks and stable evaluators; VBVR-Pro creates a closed loop with procedural generators and rule-based scorers.
papers.innovation_zh: 把视觉状态生成纳入推理过程，并让奖励可验证，可启发内容治理中的规则化视觉评测。
papers.innovation_en: It treats generated visual states as reasoning traces and makes rewards verifiable, inspiring rule-based visual evaluation for content governance.
papers.key_metrics_zh: VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-I2V-A14B overall 0.670，VBVR-Pro-SenseNova-U1 overall 0.638；verifiable scorer 与人类偏好 agreement >0.60，高于 GPT-5.5 0.54 与 Gemini-3.1-Pro 0.52。
papers.key_metrics_en: VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-I2V-A14B reaches 0.670 overall and VBVR-Pro-SenseNova-U1 reaches 0.638; the verifiable scorer exceeds 0.60 human-preference agreement versus GPT-5.5 at 0.54 and Gemini-3.1-Pro at 0.52.
